section_summary.extract_value: This section outlines several limitations of the present correlational study, including its reliance on self-report questionnaires, the brevity of some measures (body image concerns, interactions with body-focused others), and the inability to establish temporal or causal relationships between variables. It also proposes directions for future research, such as manipulating self-compassion, examining fluctuations in self-compassion, using more robust measures, disentangling subjective perceptions from actual behaviors, and assessing participants at more frequent intervals within a day.
